WITH driver_races AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, COUNT(*) AS entries,
           COUNT(DISTINCT constructor_id) AS constructors
    FROM main.results
    GROUP BY race_id, driver_id
),
season_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS races, COUNT(DISTINCT round) AS rounds,
           MIN(round) AS first_round, MAX(round) AS last_round
    FROM main.races
    GROUP BY year
),
result_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id
    FROM main.results
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM season_rounds
     WHERE races <> rounds OR first_round <> 1 OR last_round <> rounds) AS years_with_irregular_rounds,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_races WHERE entries > 1) AS driver_races_with_multiple_results,

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, s.driver_id, r.round,
           COUNT(DISTINCT s.constructor_id) AS constructors,
           MIN(s.constructor_id) AS constructor_id
    FROM main.results AS s
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = s.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, s.driver_id, r.round
),
driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_appearance, MAX(round) AS last_appearance
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
recorded_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE r.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM main.results)
),
missed AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, r.round,
           r.round BETWEEN d.first_appearance AND d.last_appearance AS is_internal
    FROM driver_seasons AS d
    JOIN recorded_races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
      ON a.year = d.year AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
),
candidate_bounds AS (
    SELECT 'all' AS race_scope, year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_missed, MAX(round) AS last_missed
    FROM missed
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'internal', year, driver_id, MIN(round), MAX(round)
    FROM missed
    WHERE is_internal
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT m.race_scope, COUNT(*) AS driver_years_with_appearances_at_both_ends,
       SUM(b.constructors > 1 OR a.constructors > 1) AS multiple_constructor_boundary_driver_years,
       SUM(b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id) AS changed_single_or_min_constructor,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id THEN m.first_missed END) AS avg_first,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id THEN m.last_missed END) AS avg_last
FROM candidate_bounds AS m
JOIN appearances AS b ON b.year = m.year AND b.driver_id = m.driver_id AND b.round = m.first_missed - 1
JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = m.year AND a.driver_id = m.driver_id AND a.round = m.last_missed + 1
GROUP BY m.race_scope

WITH recorded_races AS (
    SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE r.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM main.results)
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, s.driver_id, s.constructor_id
    FROM recorded_races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
),
driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id
    FROM appearances
),
missed_rounds AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id,
           MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
           MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM driver_seasons AS d
    JOIN recorded_races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
      ON a.year = d.year
     AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id
     AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
team_changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.year, m.driver_id, m.first_missed_round, m.last_missed_round
    FROM missed_rounds AS m
    JOIN appearances AS before_gap
      ON before_gap.year = m.year
     AND before_gap.driver_id = m.driver_id
     AND before_gap.round = m.first_missed_round - 1
    JOIN appearances AS after_gap
      ON after_gap.year = m.year
     AND after_gap.driver_id = m.driver_id
     AND after_gap.round = m.last_missed_round + 1
    WHERE before_gap.constructor_id <> after_gap.constructor_id
)
SELECT AVG(first_missed_round) AS avg_first_missed_round,
       AVG(last_missed_round) AS avg_last_missed_round
FROM team_changes
LIMIT 1
